title: 老人怎么生活
text: “我该怎么照顾父母？”我的朋友问我。现在很多年轻人面对这个问题感到压力很大。有些人认为孩子应该在家里照顾老人。这样父母能感到快乐，心情也会变好。但是，现代人的工作非常忙，很难每天花时间在家里。不管工作多累，他们都想给父母最好的生活。于是，有些人选择把老人送到专门的机构。那里有专业的医生，能保证健康。虽然这种方式方便，但有些老人会觉得孤独。不管选择哪种方式，都应该尊重老人的想法。我们可以多给他们打电话，或者周末去看看。一个温暖的家比钱更重要。社会也需要提供更多方便的设施。比如，在社区建立活动中心。让老人有地方聊天，认识新朋友。这样他们才不会觉得无聊。合理的选择能让家庭更和谐。每个人都应该思考这个问题。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what did some people choose to do for their elderly parents because they were too busy?
options: Send them to a specialized care institution
Ask siblings to take turns caring for them

questions.prompt: What problem can arise for elderly people even in a convenient care institution, according to the text?
options: They may not receive medical care
They may lose contact with doctors

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is said to be more important than money when caring for the elderly?
What does the text suggest society should build in communities to help the elderly?
Regardless of which care option is chosen, what does the text say should always be respected?

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 把 disposal
patterns.explanation: Moves the object in front of the verb to emphasise what was done to it. Often translated as "take X and …" — "I took the book and read it."
